name: Hockenheimring
notes: 1991 long GP circuit (clockwise): Motodrom, Nordkurve, forest straight, Ostkurve chicane, return straight, Agip/Sachs/Suedkurve. The forest section follows OSM's abandoned:highway=raceway ways (Streckenverlauf 1932-2001); the Nordkurve exit onto the forest straight is bridged (no longer in OSM). Includes all three 1991 chicanes: Jim Clark (1970), Ostkurve (1982) and the return-straight chicane (1970, named Senna-Schikane only from 1994; OSM's 1994 geometry is used). Excluded: today's Parabolika/Spitzkehre layout and the chicane-less Ostkurve. Traced 6895 m vs 6797 m in 1991.
